# Danrley Pereira

> Professional portfolio of Danrley Willyan da Silva Pereira, founder and AI engineer at DW Corp, based in Brasília, Brazil.

Danrley works across full-stack software engineering, AI applications, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and technical mentorship. His client work includes fixed-term Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) engagements. He also co-founded Software Craftsmanship Community Brasília.

The website is available in English, Portuguese, and Spanish. Interactive pages require JavaScript; the PDF résumés below can be retrieved directly and contain detailed experience, dates, and technologies. This site publishes professional information, not a hosted agent or callable AI service.

## Résumés

- [English résumé](https://danrleypereira.com.br/cv/cv-en.pdf): Professional experience, education, and technical skills in English.
- [Currículo em português](https://danrleypereira.com.br/cv/cv-pt.pdf): Experiência profissional, formação e competências em português.
- [Currículum en español](https://danrleypereira.com.br/cv/cv-es.pdf): Experiencia profesional, formación y competencias en español.
